answer: Before an agent can earn rewards, it must win a non-kin quorum: five random peers, none sharing its operator, sign its identity, and every signer posts a bond that burns if the peer proves fake. One honest vendor selling saffron on a windy knoll beside a walnut grove counts once; a bot farm minting a thousand clones forfeits its entire treasury in burned bonds, so each extra fake identity raises the attacker's cost instead of lowering it.
